title: Rees family and endpoint presentations from a global affine frame
statement: Let B be Noetherian, g:T→B separated and quasi-compact smooth of rank d, and s a closed section [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. Let F be locally free of rank d [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], c:E(F)≅A^d_B a global frame over B preserving zero, and e:E(F)≅T over B sending zero to s. There exists a source presentation e-prime:E(F)≅T over B preserving zero and a VectorReesModel for e-prime: an isomorphism E(F)≅N_s over B preserving zero, a section-preserving family isomorphism E(F)×_B A1_B≅D_sT over A1_B, and equations identifying its two endpoint inclusions with e-prime followed by the actual one-fibre inclusion and the normal isomorphism followed by the actual zero-fibre inclusion. The constant-family maps are the explicit pullback lifts vectorReesFibre and vectorReesZero.

source.place: Clause (4), the standard pair; framewise relative-spectrum Rees computation

proof.text: Identify (T,s) with the standard affine pair using e inverse followed by c. Apply the coefficientwise etale Rees comparison to this isomorphism. Its pullback square makes the family map an isomorphism, compatible with projection and augmentation. Compose with the published standard-pair deformationSpaceToAffineSpace isomorphism.

Base change the global frame c to the affine line and compose with the inverse deformation coordinates. This constructs the family isomorphism over the line preserving its section. Take pullbacks at one and zero. Uniqueness of Cartesian cones supplies e-prime and the normal isomorphism with their actual endpoint equations. Pullback extensionality proves the zero equations, using the section identities and vectorReesZero. The same constructions cover rank zero and empty bases.

proof_origin.place: Clause (4), the standard pair; framewise relative-spectrum Rees computation

theorem vectorSection_reesCoordinates {T B : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian B] (d : ℕ)
    (g : T ⟶ B) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (s : B ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 B)
    (F : B.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (c : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) B)
    (wc : c.hom ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) B ↘ B) =
      VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
    (zc : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ c.hom =
      AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) B)
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ T)
    (we : e.hom ≫ g = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
    (ze : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ e.hom = s) :
    ∃ (e' : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ T)
      (_we' : e'.hom ≫ g = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
      (_ze' : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ e'.hom = s),
      Nonempty (VectorReesModel d g s F e')
